en.titre: my weird little morning habits that actually work
i make my bed _with my eyes half closed_
paragraphes: it's the first win of the day, _done in 1 minute_
pillows, duvet, _done_. then i wake up

en.intro: i make it the night before, _so it's waiting for me_
paragraphes: the cold glass is what _actually wakes me up_
my brain wakes up with _my thoughts_, not everyone else's

en.intro: the quiet morning run is _my favourite thing_
paragraphes: i'd wake up with no idea what to run, so i _stayed in bed_
my tip: a running coach app like Atala sets up _your whole week_, so you just lace up
it's impossible to be grumpy _while singing_
one song, _full volume_, no talent needed

en.titre: i open the window _even in winter_
paragraphes: the cold air in my room _wakes me up_ better than coffee
